items.summary: MediAsas' numerous copayments, some of which breach BNM rules, show a misplaced burden on consumers to control medical inflation, even though it's not our fault when we fall sick. items.title: High Court’s Nicotine Ruling Mandates Government Compliance With FCTC In Historic First
items.summary: Justice Aliza Sulaiman's full written judgement on a nicotine case marks Malaysia's biggest advancement on tobacco control. The High Court mandated government compliance with WHO FCTC, the first ruling that ties domestic policy to this international treaty. items.title: Vape Tax Collection Invalid If Liquid Nicotine Exemption Cancelled, MOF Said In 2023
items.summary: Johan Merican said in 2023 that cancelling the exemption of liquid nicotine from the Poisons List will invalidate vape tax collection. As Putrajaya now upholds a court ruling nullifying the exemption, it's unclear if it must refund vape businesses >RM354m. items.title: Groups Question Nicotine Vape’s Legal Status After Government Withdrew Appeal
items.summary: MPS, MMA, and MyWatch demand clarity on the legal and regulatory status of liquid nicotine used in vapes, after the government dropped its appeal against a High Court ruling.
